description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultConnectionLimitManager class, verifying its behavior with regard to connection limits in different scenarios, including edge cases like null configuration and default limits.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionLimitManagerTest
classes.description: Test class for DefaultConnectionLimitManager, contains multiple test methods verifying connection limit logic.

methods.name: testLimitIsEqual
methods.description: Tests that when the number of current connections equals the maximum limit, the limit is considered exceeded.

methods.name: testLimitIsLower
methods.description: Tests that when the current connections exceed the maximum limit, the limit is considered exceeded.

methods.name: testLimitIsHigher
methods.description: Tests that when the current connections are below the maximum limit, the limit is not considered exceeded.

methods.name: testAutoconfigIfNotConfigured
methods.description: Tests behavior when no explicit connection limit is configured, ensuring recommended limits are used.

methods.name: testAutoconfigIfConfigIsNull
methods.description: Tests behavior when configuration is null, ensuring fallback to recommended limits.
